verdicts.reason: A does rearrange into a left-to-right banner with a large, legible headline. But the CTA sits on the beige circle and almost touches the 'e' of 'Orange'. The 'NEW FLAVOR' badge is squashed into a distorted pill and dumped bottom-left, away from the product, and the beige circle is no longer behind the phone. B is just a shrunk copy of the square centred in the middle: big empty orange areas on both sides, a tiny logo, and 'Try It Today' too small to read, so it fails fit-to-format and readability.

A is a shrunk, centred copy with dead space on both sides and a tiny logo. Worse, the beige circle and 'NEW FLAVOR' badge have been split off to the far right, so the decoration and badge float with no relation to the phone. B is a real banner layout with a strong headline, but the CTA overlaps the beige circle and crowds 'Orange'. Its badge is also squashed into a distorted pill and stranded bottom-left. B is the less bad of the two.
